authority: Automation resilience program, Nolan's directive items 13-16 (2026-09-17). This file is the governing rule for all recovery budgets; cron task bodies reference it rather than restating numbers.

authentication.rule: Max 2 auth attempts per pass (session restore, saved-login, SSO relink). NO credential entry, NO waiting on a 2FA code, NO hammering. After 2 failed attempts, quarantine: mark the surface CAPABILITY=BLOCKED, classify AUTH_FAILURE, log, end the pass quietly. Recovery requires Nolan's manual action (login / restore). This is not a reason to disable the schedule; the next pass retries.

browser_recovery.rule: Max 2 recovery attempts per pass for CDP/browser attach failures (examples: watchdog tick, SSO relink, profile window re-attach). Attempt 1 is a read-only probe; attempt 2 is one gentle recovery action. After 2 failed attempts, stop: mark the surface CAPABILITY=BLOCKED, classify DEPENDENCY_FAILURE, log, end the pass with zero engagement, no further hammering this pass. Force-kill of a live browser with session-loss risk is NEVER automatic; it is Nolan's call. The Pig commute blackout (drops ~7am and ~4pm MT) is expected infra, not a failure: first failure in those windows means wait 10 minutes, no retry.

enumeration.rule: Zero candidates when the historical baseline is nonzero is SUSPECT_ENUMERATION_FAILURE, never a successful-empty mark. Try up to 3 alternate enumeration strategies inside the same pass (examples: facebook: home-feed pages -> group scan -> business Page feeds; instagram: geo-tag -> trade hashtag -> follower-of-local; tiktok: alternate search angles; unfollow: Pages dashboard -> profile pane -> mobile view). After the 3rd failed strategy, classify ENUMERATION_FAILURE, quarantine the surface (CAPABILITY=BLOCKED), log the artifact and all 3 attempts, end the pass. A genuinely verified empty (enumeration healthy, guard-checked, zero eligible) is SUCCESS_EMPTY or ELIGIBILITY_EMPTY, not a failure.

rate_limit.rule: On a rate-limit / action-block / checkpoint signal: STOP THE PASS IMMEDIATELY (existing safety rule, unchanged and never overridden by this budget). Halve next-pass caps (existing rule). The backoff schedule governs when the surface may be re-attempted: 5m, then 10m, then 20m escalating delays; after 3 exhausted backoff cycles, quarantine the surface (CAPABILITY=BLOCKED) with a 24h cooldown. Backoff NEVER shortens pacing, NEVER raises caps, NEVER authorizes pushing through a warning. A confirmed action block or checkpoint is surfaced to Nolan in one short line per the stay-on rule.

research_validation.coordination_note: The research agent owns the final retry cap for the Meta AI research contract gate. This file PROPOSES 3. If the research agent sets a different cap, update max_retries here and keep the contract validator (~/workspace/tandem/validate-research-contract.py) and the meta-ai-intel-pass body in sync.
research_validation.rule: On research contract validation failure (exit 3 / contract_rejected): retry up to 3 times with a tightened brief before the brief is marked QUARANTINED. Each retry must change the prompt (add a failing-example exclusion), never re-run the identical brief. Unverified research is NEVER promoted into canonical PING claims; quarantine preserves the artifact, errors, attempts, and timestamps.

global_rules: Budget exhaustion always quarantines ONLY the affected surface (CAPABILITY=BLOCKED); everything else continues on schedule. No individual job, brief, surface, provider, or artifact can block unrelated work.
Budgets are per-pass, per-surface. They reset at the next scheduled pass unless a quarantine cooldown is active.
Action blocks, checkpoints, and verification challenges are terminal for the pass: stop instantly, halve caps, surface to Nolan. No budget permits pushing through one.
Budgets constrain recovery attempts only; they never authorize exceeding caps, shortening pacing, bypassing the never-re-engage guard, or disabling the schedule.

Every pass outcome is classified with the universal classifier (~/workspace/pig-fb/pass-classifier.js when available): SUCCESS_ACTION, SUCCESS_EMPTY, ENUMERATION_FAILURE, ELIGIBILITY_EMPTY, DEPENDENCY_FAILURE, AUTH_FAILURE, SURFACE_DRIFT, RATE_LIMIT, TEMPORARY_FAILURE, TERMINAL_FAILURE. Failure classes drive recovery budgets; genuine-empty classes drive yield cadence. Never confuse the two.
